title: Clause lemma for one NOT gate on Boolean sums: a set T of inputs below the NOT gate's wire pays for all but the most frequent input of T
formal_statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (S : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)) (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin m → ℕ) (i0 : Fin gates.length) (hw : ℕ) (T : Finset (Fin n)) (t0 : Fin n), (∀ i : Fin m, 2 ≤ (S i).card) → (∀ i j : Fin m, i ≠ j → (S i ∩ S j).card ≤ 1) → (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ q : Fin gates.length, (gates.get q).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → q = i0) → (gates.get i0).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → (gates.get i0).inputs.head? = some hw → hw < n + i0.val → (∀ (o : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out o⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ S o, x v = true)) → (∀ y : Fin n → Bool, (∀ t ∈ T, y t = false) → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, hw⟩ (List.ofFn y) = false) → t0 ∈ T → (∀ t ∈ T, (Finset.univ.filter (fun a : Fin m => t ∈ S a)).card ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun b : Fin m => t0 ∈ S b)).card) → 1 + ∑ s : Fin m, ((S s).card - 1) ≤ gates.length + ∑ u ∈ T.erase t0, (Finset.univ.filter (fun c : Fin m => u ∈ S c)).card
plain_statement: Sets S_1..S_m of n inputs, each of at least 2, two sharing at most one input; deg t is the number of sets holding input t. A list of AND, OR and NOT gates on at most two wires, exactly one NOT gate, reading an earlier wire h, gives the OR of each set on every input. Let T be inputs such that h is false whenever every input of T is false, and t0 one of largest degree in T. Then the list has at least 1 + sum over i of (|S_i| - 1) - sum over t in T other than t0 of deg t gates. Conjecture; computed, not checked: no failure found by script.
